name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE
tooltip:
Prim parameter for materials using integer face, integer alpha_mode, integer alpha_cutoff.
Defines how the alpha channel of the diffuse texture should be rendered.
Valid options for alpha_mode are PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND, _NONE, _MASK, and _EMISSIVE.
alpha_cutoff is used only for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_MASK.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND
tooltip:
Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE.
Indicates that the diffuse texture's alpha channel should be rendered as alpha-blended.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_EMISSIVE
tooltip:
Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE.
Indicates that the diffuse texture's alpha channel should be rendered as an emissivity mask.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_MASK
tooltip:
Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE.
Indicates that the diffuse texture's alpha channel should be rendered as fully opaque for alpha values above alpha_cutoff and fully transparent otherwise.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_NONE
tooltip:
Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE.
Indicates that the diffuse texture's alpha channel should be ignored.

tooltip: A vector <x, y, z> which is the acceleration to apply on particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_BEGIN
tooltip: Area in radians specifying where particles will NOT be created (for ANGLE patterns)

name: PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_END
tooltip: Area in radians filled with particles (for ANGLE patterns) (if lower than PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_BEGIN, acts as PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_BEGIN itself, and PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_BEGIN acts as PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_END).

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_PART_COUNT
tooltip: How many particles to release in a burst.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_RADIUS
tooltip: What distance from the center of the object to create the particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_RATE
tooltip: How often to release a particle burst (float seconds).

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_SPEED_MAX
tooltip: Maximum speed that a particle should be moving.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_SPEED_MIN
tooltip: Minimum speed that a particle should be moving.

name: PSYS_SRC_INNERANGLE
tooltip:
Specifies the inner angle of the arc created by the PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE or PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE source pattern.
			The area specified will NOT have particles in it.

name: PSYS_SRC_MAX_AGE
tooltip: How long this particle system should last, 0.0 means forever.

name: PSYS_SRC_OMEGA
tooltip: Sets the angular velocity to rotate the axis that SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE and SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE use.

name: PSYS_SRC_OUTERANGLE
tooltip:
Specifies the outer angle of the arc created by the PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE or PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE source pattern.
			The area between the outer and inner angle will be filled with particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN
tooltip:
The pattern which is used to generate particles.
			Use one of the following values: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN Values.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE
tooltip: Shoot particles across a 2 dimensional area defined by the arc created from PSYS_SRC_OUTERANGLE. There will be an open area defined by PSYS_SRC_INNERANGLE within the larger arc.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE
tooltip: Shoot particles out in a 3 dimensional cone with an outer arc of PSYS_SRC_OUTERANGLE and an inner open area defined by PSYS_SRC_INNERANGLE.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_DROP
tooltip: Drop particles at the source position.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_EXPLODE
tooltip: Shoot particles out in all directions, using the burst parameters.

name: PSYS_SRC_TARGET_KEY
tooltip: The key of a target object to move towards if PSYS_PART_TARGET_POS_MASK is enabled.

name: PSYS_SRC_TEXTURE
tooltip: An asset name for the texture to use for the particles.

name: PUBLIC_CHANNEL
tooltip: PUBLIC_CHANNEL is an integer constant that, when passed to llSay, llWhisper, or llShout as a channel parameter, will print text to the publicly heard chat channel.

name: PURSUIT_FUZZ_FACTOR
tooltip: Selects a random destination near the offset.

name: PURSUIT_INTERCEPT
tooltip: Define whether the character attempts to predict the target's location.

name: PURSUIT_OFFSET
tooltip: Go to a position offset from the target.

name: PU_EVADE_HIDDEN
tooltip: Triggered when an llEvade character thinks it has hidden from its pursuer.

name: PU_EVADE_SPOTTED
tooltip: Triggered when an llEvade character switches from hiding to running

name: PU_FAILURE_INVALID_GOAL
tooltip: Goal is not on the navigation-mesh and cannot be reached.

name: PU_FAILURE_INVALID_START
tooltip: Character cannot navigate from the current location - e.g., the character is off the navmesh or too high above it.

name: PU_FAILURE_NO_NAVMESH
tooltip: This is a fatal error reported to a character when there is no navmesh for the region. This usually indicates a server failure and users should file a bug report and include the time and region in which they received this message.

name: PU_FAILURE_NO_VALID_DESTINATION
tooltip: There is no good place for the character to go - e.g., it is patrolling and all the patrol points are now unreachable.

name: PU_FAILURE_TARGET_GONE
tooltip: Target (for llPursue or llEvade) can no longer be tracked - e.g., it left the region or is an avatar that is now more than about 30m outside the region.

name: PU_FAILURE_UNREACHABLE
tooltip: Goal is no longer reachable for some reason - e.g., an obstacle blocks the path.

name: PU_GOAL_REACHED
tooltip: Character has reached the goal and will stop or choose a new goal (if wandering).

name: PU_SLOWDOWN_DISTANCE_REACHED
tooltip: Character is near current goal.

name: RAD_TO_DEG
tooltip: 57.2957795 - Number of degrees per radian. You can use this number to convert radians to degrees by multiplying the radians by this number.

name: REQUIRE_LINE_OF_SIGHT
tooltip: Define whether the character needs a line-of-sight to give chase.

name: RESTITUTION
tooltip: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the density value. Must be between 0.0 and 1.0

name: REVERSE
tooltip: Play animation in reverse direction.

name: ROTATE
tooltip: Animate texture rotation.

name: SCALE
tooltip: Animate the texture scale.

name: SCRIPTED
tooltip: Scripted in-world objects.

name: SIM_STAT_PCT_CHARS_STEPPED
tooltip:
Returns the % of pathfinding characters skipped each frame, averaged over the last minute.
The returned value corresponds to the "Characters Updated" stat in the viewer's Statistics Bar.

name: SMOOTH
tooltip: Slide in the X direction, instead of playing separate frames.

name: SQRT2
tooltip: 1.41421356 - The square root of 2.

name: STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB
tooltip:
Controls whether the object can be grabbed.
A grab is the default action when in third person, and is available as the hand tool in build mode. This is useful for physical objects that you don't want other people to be able to trivially disturb. The default is FALSE

name: STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB_OBJECT
tooltip: Prevent click-and-drag movement on all prims in the object.

name: STATUS_BOUNDS_ERROR
tooltip: Argument(s) passed to function had a bounds error.

name: STATUS_DIE_AT_EDGE
tooltip:
Controls whether the object is returned to the owners inventory if it wanders off the edge of the world.
It is useful to set this status TRUE for things like bullets or rockets. The default is TRUE

name: STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR
tooltip: An internal error occurred.

name: STATUS_MALFORMED_PARAMS
tooltip: Function was called with malformed parameters.

name: STATUS_NOT_FOUND
tooltip: Object or other item was not found.

name: STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
tooltip: Feature not supported.

name: STATUS_OK
tooltip: Result of function call was a success.

name: STATUS_PHANTOM
tooltip:
Controls/indicates whether the object collides or not.
Setting the value to TRUE makes the object non-colliding with all objects. It is a good idea to use this for most objects that move or rotate, but are non-physical. It is also useful for simulating volumetric lighting. The default is FALSE.

name: STATUS_PHYSICS
tooltip:
Controls/indicates whether the object moves physically.
This controls the same flag that the UI check-box for Physical controls. The default is FALSE.

name: STATUS_ROTATE_Z
tooltip:
Controls/indicates whether the object can physically rotate around
			the specific axis or not. This flag has no meaning
			for non-physical objects. Set the value to FALSE
			if you want to disable rotation around that axis. The
			default is TRUE for a physical object.
			A useful example to think about when visualizing
			the effect is a sit-and-spin device. They spin around the
			Z axis (up) but not around the X or Y axis.

name: STATUS_SANDBOX
tooltip:
Controls/indicates whether the object can cross region boundaries
			and move more than 20 meters from its creation
			point. The default if FALSE.

name: STATUS_TYPE_MISMATCH
tooltip: Argument(s) passed to function had a type mismatch.

name: STATUS_WHITELIST_FAILED
tooltip: Whitelist Failed.

name: TRAVERSAL_TYPE
tooltip: One of TRAVERSAL_TYPE_FAST, TRAVERSAL_TYPE_SLOW, and TRAVERSAL_TYPE_NONE.

name: TRUE
tooltip: An integer constant for boolean comparisons. Has the value '1'.

name: TWO_PI
tooltip: 6.28318530 - The radians of a circle.

name: TYPE_FLOAT
tooltip: The list entry is a float.

name: TYPE_INTEGER
tooltip: The list entry is an integer.

name: TYPE_INVALID
tooltip: The list entry is invalid.

name: TYPE_KEY
tooltip: The list entry is a key.

name: TYPE_ROTATION
tooltip: The list entry is a rotation.

name: TYPE_STRING
tooltip: The list entry is a string.

name: TYPE_VECTOR
tooltip: The list entry is a vector.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY
tooltip: A slider between minimum (0.0) and maximum (1.0) deflection of angular orientation. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of angular deflection such that the vehicles preferred axis of motion points toward its real velocity.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The time-scale for exponential success of linear deflection deflection. Its another way to specify the strength of the vehicles tendency to reorient itself so that its preferred axis of motion agrees with its true velocity.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE
tooltip:
A vector of timescales for exponential decay of the vehicles angular velocity about its preferred axes of motion (at, left, up).
			Range = [0.07, inf) seconds for each element of the vector.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for exponential decay of the angular motors magnitude.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION
tooltip: The direction and magnitude (in preferred frame) of the vehicles angular motor.The vehicle will accelerate (or decelerate if necessary) to match its velocity to its motor.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for exponential approach to full angular motor velocity.

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_EFFICIENCY
tooltip: A slider between anti (-1.0), none (0.0), and maxmum (1.0) banking strength.

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_MIX
tooltip: A slider between static (0.0) and dynamic (1.0) banking. "Static" means the banking scales only with the angle of roll, whereas "dynamic" is a term that also scales with the vehicles linear speed.

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for banking to exponentially approach its maximum effect. This is another way to scale the strength of the banking effect, however it affects the term that is proportional to the difference between what the banking behavior is trying to do, and what the vehicle is actually doing.

name: VEHICLE_BUOYANCY
tooltip: A slider between minimum (0.0) and maximum anti-gravity (1.0).

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_GLOBAL_HEIGHT
tooltip: Hover at global height.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_TERRAIN_ONLY
tooltip: Ignore water height when hovering.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_UP_ONLY
tooltip: Hover does not push down. Use this flag for hovering vehicles that should be able to jump above their hover height.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_WATER_ONLY
tooltip: Ignore terrain height when hovering.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_MOTOR_UP
tooltip: Prevents ground vehicles from motoring into the sky.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_ROLL_ONLY
tooltip: For vehicles with vertical attractor that want to be able to climb/dive, for instance, aeroplanes that want to use the banking feature.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP
tooltip: This flag prevents linear deflection parallel to world z-axis. This is useful for preventing ground vehicles with large linear deflection, like bumper cars, from climbing their linear deflection into the sky.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_FLY_UP
tooltip: Old, changed to VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_EFFICIENCY
tooltip: A slider between minimum (0.0 = bouncy) and maximum (1.0 = fast as possible) damped motion of the hover behavior.

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_HEIGHT
tooltip: The height (above the terrain or water, or global) at which the vehicle will try to hover.

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_TIMESCALE
tooltip: Period of time (in seconds) for the vehicle to achieve its hover height.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY
tooltip: A slider between minimum (0.0) and maximum (1.0) deflection of linear velocity. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of linear deflection.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for exponential success of linear deflection deflection. It is another way to specify how much time it takes for the vehicles linear velocity to be redirected to its preferred axis of motion.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE
tooltip:
A vector of timescales for exponential decay of the vehicles linear velocity along its preferred axes of motion (at, left, up).
			Range = [0.07, inf) seconds for each element of the vector.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for exponential decay of the linear motors magnitude.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION
tooltip:
The direction and magnitude (in preferred frame) of the vehicles linear motor. The vehicle will accelerate (or decelerate if necessary) to match its velocity to its motor.
			Range of magnitude = [0, 30] meters/second.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The timescale for exponential approach to full linear motor velocity.

name: VEHICLE_REFERENCE_FRAME
tooltip: A rotation of the vehicles preferred axes of motion and orientation (at, left, up) with respect to the vehicles local frame (x, y, z).

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_AIRPLANE
tooltip:
Uses linear deflection for lift, no hover, and banking to turn.
See http://wiki.secondlife.com/wiki/VEHICLE_TYPE_AIRPLANE

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BALLOON
tooltip:
Hover, and friction, but no deflection.
See http://wiki.secondlife.com/wiki/VEHICLE_TYPE_BALLOON

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BOAT
tooltip:
Hovers over water with lots of friction and some anglar deflection.
See http://wiki.secondlife.com/wiki/VEHICLE_TYPE_BOAT

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_CAR
tooltip:
Another vehicle that bounces along the ground but needs the motors to be driven from external controls or timer events.
See http://wiki.secondlife.com/wiki/VEHICLE_TYPE_CAR

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_SLED
tooltip:
Simple vehicle that bumps along the ground, and likes to move along its local x-axis.
See http://wiki.secondlife.com/wiki/VEHICLE_TYPE_SLED

name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_EFFICIENCY
tooltip: A slider between minimum (0.0 = wobbly) and maximum (1.0 = firm as possible) stability of the vehicle to keep itself upright.

name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_TIMESCALE
tooltip: The period of wobble, or timescale for exponential approach, of the vehicle to rotate such that its preferred "up" axis is oriented along the worlds "up" axis.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCES_DISABLED
tooltip: The region currently has experiences disabled.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_DISABLED
tooltip: The experience owner has temporarily disabled the experience.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_SUSPENDED
tooltip: The experience has been suspended by Linden Customer Support.

name: XP_ERROR_INVALID_EXPERIENCE
tooltip: The script is associated with an experience that no longer exists.

name: XP_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETERS
tooltip: One of the string arguments was too big to fit in the key-value store.

name: XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND
tooltip: The requested key does not exist.

name: XP_ERROR_MATURITY_EXCEEDED
tooltip: The content rating of the experience exceeds that of the region.

name: XP_ERROR_NONE
tooltip: No error was detected.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
tooltip: The sim was unable to verify the validity of the experience. Retrying after a short wait is advised.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED
tooltip: This experience is not allowed to run by the requested agent.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED_LAND
tooltip: This experience is not allowed to run on the current region.

name: XP_ERROR_NO_EXPERIENCE
tooltip: This script is not associated with an experience.

name: XP_ERROR_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
tooltip: An attempted write data to the key-value store failed due to the data quota being met.

name: XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE
tooltip: A checked update failed due to an out of date request.

name: XP_ERROR_STORAGE_EXCEPTION
tooltip: Unable to communicate with the key-value store.

name: XP_ERROR_STORE_DISABLED
tooltip: The key-value store is currently disabled on this region.

name: XP_ERROR_THROTTLED
tooltip: The call failed due to too many recent calls.

name: XP_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ERROR
tooltip: Other unknown error.

name: at_rot_target
signature: at_rot_target(integer TargetNumber, rotation TargetRotation, rotation CurrentRotation)
tooltip: This event is triggered when a script comes within a defined angle of a target rotation. The range and rotation, are set by a call to llRotTarget.

name: at_target
signature: at_target(integer TargetNumber, vector TargetPosition, vector CurrentPosition)
tooltip: This event is triggered when the scripted object comes within a defined range of the target position, defined by the llTarget function call.

name: attach
tooltip: This event is triggered whenever an object is attached or detached from an avatar. If it is attached, the key of the avatar it is attached to is passed in, otherwise NULL_KEY is.

name: changed
tooltip: Triggered when various events change the object. The change argument will be a bit-field of CHANGED_* constants.

name: collision
tooltip:
This event is raised while another object, or avatar, is colliding with the object the script is attached to.
			The number of detected objects is passed to the script. Information on those objects may be gathered via the llDetected* functions.

name: collision_end
tooltip:
This event is raised when another object, or avatar, stops colliding with the object the script is attached to.
			The number of detected objects is passed to the script. Information on those objects may be gathered via the llDetected* library functions.

name: collision_start
tooltip:
This event is raised when another object, or avatar, starts colliding with the object the script is attached to.
			The number of detected objects is passed to the script. Information on those objects may be gathered via the llDetected* library functions.

name: control
signature: control(key AvatarID, integer Levels, integer Edges)
tooltip:
Once a script has the ability to grab control inputs from the avatar, this event will be used to pass the commands into the script.
			The levels and edges are bit-fields of control constants.

name: dataserver
tooltip:
This event is triggered when the requested data is returned to the script.
			Data may be requested by the llRequestAgentData, llRequestInventoryData, and llGetNotecardLine function calls, for example.

name: default
tooltip:
All scripts must have a default state, which is the first state entered when the script starts.
If another state is defined before the default state, the compiler will report a syntax error.

name: do
else
email
signature: email(string Time, string Address, string Subject, string Body, integer NumberRemaining)
tooltip:
This event is triggered when an email sent to this script arrives.
			The number remaining tells how many more emails are known to be still pending.

name: experience_permissions_denied
tooltip: Describes why the Experience permissions were denied for the agent.

name: float
tooltip:
32 bit floating point value.
The range is 1.175494351E-38 to 3.402823466E+38.

name: for
http_request

tooltip: Triggered when task receives an HTTP request.

name: http_response

tooltip: This event handler is invoked when an HTTP response is received for a pending llHTTPRequest request or if a pending request fails or times out.

name: if
integer

32 bit integer value.
−2,147,483,648 and +2,147,483,647 (that is 0x80000000 to 0x7FFFFFFF in hex).

name: jump
tooltip:
jump statement
jump <label>

tooltip:
A 128 bit unique identifier (UUID).

name: land_collision
tooltip: This event is raised when the object the script is attached to is colliding with the ground.

name: land_collision_end
tooltip: This event is raised when the object the script is attached to stops colliding with the ground.

name: land_collision_start
tooltip: This event is raised when the object the script is attached to begins to collide with the ground.

name: link_message
signature: link_message(integer SendersLink, integer Value, string Text, key ID)
tooltip: Triggered when object receives a link message via llMessageLinked function call.

name: list
tooltip:
A collection of other data types.
Lists are signified by square brackets surrounding their elements; the elements inside are separated by commas. e.g. [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] or ["Yes", "No", "Perhaps"].

name: listen
signature: listen(integer Channel, string Name, key ID, string Text)
tooltip:
This event is raised whenever a chat message matching the constraints set in the llListen command is received. The name and ID of the speaker, as well as the message, are passed in as parameters.
			Channel 0 is the public chat channel that all avatars see as chat text. Channels 1 through 2,147,483,648 are private channels that are not sent to avatars but other scripts can listen on those channels.

name: llAbs
tooltip: Returns the absolute (positive) version of Value.

name: llAcos
tooltip: Returns the arc-cosine of Value, in radians.

name: llAddToLandBanList
tooltip:
Add avatar ID to the parcel ban list for the specified number of Hours.
A value of 0 for Hours will add the agent indefinitely.
The smallest value that Hours will accept is 0.01; anything smaller will be seen as 0.
When values that small are used, it seems the function bans in approximately 30 second increments (Probably 36 second increments, as 0.01 of an hour is 36 seconds).
Residents teleporting to a parcel where they are banned will be redirected to a neighbouring parcel.

name: llAddToLandPassList
tooltip: Add avatar ID to the land pass list, for a duration of Hours.

name: llAdjustSoundVolume
tooltip:
Adjusts the volume (0.0 - 1.0) of the currently playing attached sound.
This function has no effect on sounds started with llTriggerSound.

name: llAgentInExperience
tooltip: Returns TRUE if the agent is in the Experience and the Experience can run in the current location.

name: llAllowInventoryDrop
tooltip: If Flag == TRUE, users without object modify permissions can still drop inventory items into the object.

name: llAngleBetween
tooltip: Returns the angle, in radians, between rotations Rot1 and Rot2.

name: llApplyImpulse
tooltip:
Applies impulse to the object.
If Local == TRUE, apply the Force in local coordinates; otherwise, apply the Force in global coordinates.
This function only works on physical objects.

name: llApplyRotationalImpulse
tooltip:
Applies rotational impulse to the object.
If Local == TRUE, apply the Force in local coordinates; otherwise, apply the Force in global coordinates.
This function only works on physical objects.

name: llAsin
tooltip: Returns the arc-sine, in radians, of Value.

name: llAtan2
tooltip: Returns the arc-tangent2 of y, x.

name: llAttachToAvatar
tooltip:
Attach to avatar at point AttachmentPoint.
Requires the PERMISSION_ATTACH runtime permission.

name: llAttachToAvatarTemp
tooltip: Follows the same convention as llAttachToAvatar, with the exception that the object will not create new inventory for the user, and will disappear on detach or disconnect.

name: llAvatarOnLinkSitTarget
tooltip:
If an avatar is sitting on the link's sit target, return the avatar's key, NULL_KEY otherwise.
Returns a key that is the UUID of the user seated on the specified link's prim.

name: llAvatarOnSitTarget
tooltip:
If an avatar is seated on the sit target, returns the avatar's key, otherwise NULL_KEY.
This only will detect avatars sitting on sit targets defined with llSitTarget.

name: llAxes2Rot
signature: rotation llAxes2Rot(vector Forward, vector Left, vector Up)
tooltip: Returns the rotation represented by coordinate axes Forward, Left, and Up.

name: llAxisAngle2Rot
tooltip: Returns the rotation that is a generated Angle about Axis.

name: llBase64ToInteger
tooltip:
Returns an integer that is the Text, Base64 decoded as a big endian integer.
Returns zero if Text is longer then 8 characters. If Text contains fewer then 6 characters, the return value is unpredictable.

name: llBase64ToString
tooltip:
Converts a Base64 string to a conventional string.
If the conversion creates any unprintable characters, they are converted to question marks.

name: llBreakAllLinks
tooltip: De-links all prims in the link set (requires permission PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS be set).

name: llBreakLink
tooltip: De-links the prim with the given link number (requires permission PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS be set).

name: llCSV2List
tooltip: Create a list from a string of comma separated values specified in Text.

name: llCastRay
signature: list llCastRay(vector Start, vector End, list Options)
tooltip:
Casts a ray into the physics world from 'start' to 'end' and returns data according to details in Options.
Reports collision data for intersections with objects.
Return value: [UUID_1, {link_number_1}, hit_position_1, {hit_normal_1}, UUID_2, {link_number_2}, hit_position_2, {hit_normal_2}, ... , status_code] where {} indicates optional data.

name: llCeil
tooltip: Returns smallest integer value >= Value.

name: llClearCameraParams
tooltip: Resets all camera parameters to default values and turns off scripted camera control.

name: llClearLinkMedia
tooltip:
Clears (deletes) the media and all parameters from the given Face on the linked prim.
Returns an integer that is a STATUS_* flag, which details the success/failure of the operation.

name: llClearPrimMedia
tooltip:
Clears (deletes) the media and all parameters from the given Face.
Returns an integer that is a STATUS_* flag which details the success/failure of the operation.

name: llCloseRemoteDataChannel
tooltip: Closes the specified XML-RPC channel.

name: llCloud
tooltip: Returns the cloud density at the object's position + Offset.

name: llCollisionFilter
signature: void llCollisionFilter(string ObjectName, key ObjectID, integer Accept)
tooltip: Specify an empty string or NULL_KEY for Accept, to not filter on the corresponding parameter.

name: llCollisionSound
tooltip:
Suppress default collision sounds, replace default impact sounds with ImpactSound.
The ImpactSound must be in the object inventory.
Supply an empty string to suppress collision sounds.

name: llCollisionSprite
tooltip: Suppress default collision sprites, replace default impact sprite with ImpactSprite; found in the object inventory (empty string to just suppress).

name: llCos
tooltip: Returns the cosine of Theta (Theta in radians).

name: llCreateCharacter
tooltip:
Convert link-set to AI/Physics character.
Creates a path-finding entity, known as a "character", from the object containing the script. Required to activate use of path-finding functions.
Options is a list of key/value pairs.

name: llCreateKeyValue
tooltip: Starts an asychronous transaction to create a key-value pair. Will fail with XP_ERROR_STORAGE_EXCEPTION if the key already exists. The dataserver callback will be executed with the key returned from this call and a string describing the result. The result is a two element commma-delimited list. The first item is an integer specifying if the transaction succeeded (1) or not (0). In the failure case, the second item will be an integer corresponding to one of the XP_ERROR_... constants. In the success case the second item will be the value passed to the function.

name: llCreateLink
tooltip:
Attempt to link the object the script is in, to target (requires permission PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS be set).
Requires permission PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS be set.

name: llDataSizeKeyValue
tooltip: Starts an asychronous transaction the request the used and total amount of data allocated for the Experience. The dataserver callback will be executed with the key returned from this call and a string describing the result. The result is commma-delimited list. The first item is an integer specifying if the transaction succeeded (1) or not (0). In the failure case, the second item will be an integer corresponding to one of the XP_ERROR_... constants. In the success case the second item will be the the amount in use and the third item will be the total available.

name: llDeleteCharacter
tooltip:
Convert link-set from AI/Physics character to Physics object.

name: llDialog
signature: void llDialog(key AvatarID, string Text, list Buttons, integer Channel)
tooltip:
Shows a dialog box on the avatar's screen with the message.

				Up to 12 strings in the list form buttons.

				If a button is clicked, the name is chatted on Channel.
Opens a "notify box" in the given avatars screen displaying the message.

			Up to twelve buttons can be specified in a list of strings. When the user clicks a button, the name of the button is said on the specified channel.

			Channels work just like llSay(), so channel 0 can be heard by everyone.

			The chat originates at the object's position, not the avatar's position, even though it is said as the avatar (uses avatar's UUID and Name etc.).

			Examples:

			llDialog(who, "Are you a boy or a girl?", [ "Boy", "Girl" ], -4913);

			llDialog(who, "This shows only an OK button.", [], -192);

			llDialog(who, "This chats so you can 'hear' it.", ["Hooray"], 0);
